segments.name: Marketing
segments.description: Markets motor fuel and convenience merchandise through Murphy USA, Murphy Express and QuickChek stores, and supplies fuel to unbranded wholesale customers.
segments.evidence: The Marketing segment includes our retail marketing stores and product supply and wholesale assets.

revenueModel.text: Retail consumers pay for motor fuel and convenience merchandise at Company stores, and unbranded wholesale customers pay for fuel supplied through terminals and pipeline positions.
revenueModel.evidence: In addition, we market fuel to unbranded wholesale customers through a mixture of Company-owned and third-party product distribution terminals and pipeline positions.
